anchors.title: Federation Square & ACMI
anchors.description: Melbourne's civic plaza on the north bank of the Yarra hosts ACMI — the Australian Centre for the Moving Image — with free access to its world-renowned cinema and screen-culture exhibition. Major events, food trucks and big-screen sports almost every weekend.

anchors.title: National Gallery of Victoria (NGV International)
anchors.description: Australia's oldest and most-visited public art gallery, free to enter. Iconic stained-glass Great Hall ceiling, blockbuster international exhibitions and the country's deepest collection of European art.

anchors.title: Hosier Lane Street Art
anchors.description: Melbourne's most photographed laneway — a constantly-evolving outdoor gallery of large-scale street art. Bring a camera; the murals change weekly. Free, walkable from Federation Square.

anchors.title: Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria
anchors.description: 38 hectares of riverside gardens beside the Shrine of Remembrance. The Aboriginal Heritage Walk, the Tan jogging track and the Children's Garden. Free entry every day of the year.

anchors.title: St Kilda Beach & Pier
anchors.description: Iconic palm-lined bay beach with the historic Luna Park amusements next door. Walk to the end of the pier at dusk to spot the little penguin colony that nests in the breakwater rocks.

anchors.title: MCG Tour — Melbourne Cricket Ground
anchors.description: Behind-the-scenes tour of the 100,000-seat 'G — the spiritual home of Australian cricket and AFL. Walk on the ground itself, sit in the players' rooms and visit the National Sports Museum.

anchors.title: Yarra River Cruise
anchors.description: One-hour scenic cruise along the Yarra from Southbank past the sports precinct and into the river bends near the Botanic Gardens. Boats depart Berths 1-3 at Southgate every 30 minutes.

TUESDAY.title: Queen Vic Market — Day Market
TUESDAY.description: 150-year-old open-air market — the largest in the Southern Hemisphere. 600 traders selling fresh produce, deli imports, clothing and souvenirs. Open Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

WEDNESDAY.title: NGV Friday Nights / Wednesday Lates
WEDNESDAY.description: Late-night exhibition opening with live performances, talks and pop-up bars throughout the NGV. Check the NGV calendar — Wednesdays during major summer shows, Fridays year-round.

FRIDAY.title: Rooftop Cinema
FRIDAY.description: Open-air cinema on top of Curtin House on Swanston Street. New releases and cult classics, with deck chairs, a bar and a 1970s-style rooftop pool. Sessions every night in summer, weather permitting.

SATURDAY.title: Queen Victoria Market — Saturday
SATURDAY.description: The biggest day at QVM. Add a coffee at the Market Lane stand and a doughnut from American Doughnut Kitchen to your produce run.

SATURDAY.title: Saturday Football at the 'G
SATURDAY.description: AFL season runs March to September: grab a ticket on the day for an MCG match. In the off-season the venue hosts cricket Tests and BBL twenty20s.

SUNDAY.title: Camberwell Sunday Market
SUNDAY.description: Melbourne's largest Sunday market — 370+ stalls of pre-loved fashion, vintage and bric-à-brac. 6:30am-12:30pm every Sunday in Station Street car park. Coffee carts on site.
